Corporate actions tracker | Robinhood

## September 4, 2026

## September 4, 2026

National Healthcare Properties, Inc. 7.375% Series A Cumulative Redeemable Perpetual Preferred Stock (NHPAP) was liquidated. This means that shares were removed and shareholders will receive $25.0000 per share in cash.

---

CollPlant Biotechnologies (CLGN) performed a 1 for 10 Reverse Split. This means shareholders will now hold 1 share of CLGN for every 10 shares previously held. Fractional shares resulting from the split will be retained.

---

Turnstone Biologics (TSBX^) contingent value rights (CVR) expired worthless.

---

Tantech Holdings (TANH) performed a 1 for 50 Reverse Split. This means shareholders will now hold 1 share of TANH for every 50 shares previously held. Fractional shares resulting from the split will be retained.

---

JFB Construction Holdings Class A (JFB) performed a ticker change to XTND and performed a 1:1 CUSIP change.

---

LivePerson (LPSN) performed a stock merger. Shareholders will receive 0.4673 new shares of SOUN for each old share of LPSN previously held. Fractional shares will be retained.

---

Bitcoin Depot Inc. (BTMCQ) was declared worthless.

---

Bit Origin Limited Class A (BTOG) performed a ticker change to SGRX, and changed its corporate name to Sangrix.

## September 3, 2026

## September 3, 2026

Amphenol (APH) performed a 2 for 1 Forward Split. This means shareholders will now hold 2 shares of APH for every 1 share previously held.

---

Apogee Therapeutics, Inc. (APGE) performed a cash merger. This means that shares were removed and shareholders will receive $135.11 per share in cash.

---

NCS Multistage (NCSM) performed a stock merger. Shareholders will receive 0.5537 new shares of WFRD for each old share of NCSM previously held. Fractional shares will be retained.

---

Arqit Quantum Inc. Warrants (ARQQW) expired worthless.

---

Natuzzi (NTZ) was delisted pending a stock liquidation. Details are still pending.
